entries.justification: pre-existing; ratcheted DOWN 1843->1820 by fix/verbatim-worker-nested-metadata (batch vector resolution moved to verbatimBatch.ts, orphaned wrapper removed), then refreshed 1820->1770 on main (unrelated to this change). Separately, +212 by fix/search-worker-call-cancellation (defect 1, 3.20.2), based off the pre-refresh 1820 count: +27 for an additive optional `gate` param threaded through search/searchByVector/bm25Search, the ensureFtsIndex two-phase (fast-path-then-exclusive) rewrite, and the LORE_TEST_WORKER_HOOKS-gated __testHold/__testCounters/checkGateDeadline test surface; +135 in the 3.20.2 independent-review remediation (same branch, follow-up commit) — finding 1 (BLOCKING): cachedRead()'s single-flight promise redesigned as a reference-counted SearchFlight (own AbortController, refCount, per-caller buildOwnAbort() wrapper) so a caller's own signal/deadline rejects only that caller, and the shared native call is aborted only once every joined caller has individually given up. Merged total (1770 base + 212) verified against the actual post-merge file via `wc -l`, not summed blindly across the two branches' independent deltas. Then +14 by the 3.21 i2 sync-main merge (3.21 step 3(c)'s NullEmbeddingProvider no-op guards in store()/the batch path + listIds' optional includeHistory, additive and in regions disjoint from 3.20.2's changes); merged total verified via `wc -l`. Then +57 (1996->2053) by feat/3.23-d7-piece-vectors (D7a, storage layer only): a `pieceIndex: LancePieceIndex` field + `pieceVectorsIntent: boolean` (constructed unconditionally, reusing the same embeddingProvider instance as the canonical store — never a second LocalEmbeddingProvider), one-line best-effort hooks (upsertForRows/deleteForIds, each `.catch`-guarded and logged, never thrown) added to store(), storeBatch(), bulkAddPrebuiltRows(), bulkUpsertPrebuiltRows(), physicalDelete(), physicalDeleteMany(), tombstone() and close(), an initialize() block that opens/validates the derived piece index (best-effort, does not block canonical open on failure), and two new public delegators (searchPieces, pieceIndexStatus) for the out-of-scope retrieval-routing slice to build on. Off by default (`pieceVectorsIntent` defaults false via `opts?.pieceVectors ?? false`) — no behavioural change to any existing write path when the feature is not opted in. Verified via `wc -l`. Then +36 (2053->2089) by feat/3.23-d7-piece-vectors (D7b, retrieval routing), later corrected in place (see next entry) — D7a's stub `searchPieces(queryVector: number[], topK: number)` widened toward the real retrieval-routing seam, threading `VerbatimQueryFilter`/D2-E2 filter pushdown, `actorScopes ?? getCurrentActorScopes()` and a minimal `gate?.signal?.aborted` check (not the full cachedRead/writeGate/searchGate machinery, a deliberate scope call for this slice) down to `LancePieceIndex.searchPieces` — plus one new public getter, `pieceVectorsIntentOn()`, exposing this store's own construction-time-resolved intent (distinct from `pieceIndexStatus().valid`, needed because a sidecar can stay open+valid from a prior run after intent is later turned off — resolveSeedStore's routing gate needs both signals). Verified via `wc -l`. Then +9 (2089->2098), same branch, same-day fix: the first D7b pass had `searchPieces` take `query: string` and unconditionally call `embeddingProvider.embedQuery(query)`, which broke 8 of 9 D7a Section-C tests in test/d7-piece-index-unit.ts (`TypeError: text.startsWith is not a function`) because those tests call the store-level `searchPieces` directly with a pre-embedded `number[]` vector, not a string — a real regression against D7a's own contract, caught by actually running T1 rather than only typechecking. Fixed by widening the parameter to `query: string | number[]` and embedding only when given a string (`typeof query === 'string' ? await embedQuery(query) : query`), mirroring the `string | number[]` convention `SqlitePieceIndex.searchPieces` (D7a) already established on the SQLite engine side; production callers (`pieceAwareSearch`) still always pass the raw string, so behaviour there is unchanged, and T1 (both engines) now passes 17/17 under Node 22 (the worktree's required engine — an initial run under a stray Node 20 shell showed 9 unrelated better-sqlite3 NODE_MODULE_VERSION failures on the sqlite variant, not a real bug, resolved by `nvm use 22`). Verified via `wc -l`. Then +7 (2098->2105), same branch (D7c, migration/lifecycle slice): one new public accessor, `pieceIndexForMigration()`, returning this store's own already-constructed LancePieceIndex instance for the new `lore migrate piece-vectors` CLI (engines/pieces/pieceIndexBuild.ts) to reuse rather than re-deriving a second Lance connection — every other caller still goes through searchPieces()/pieceIndexStatus(). Verified via `wc -l`.

Then +1 by the 3.21 i2 sync-main merge (3.21 step 2's net +1 from the VerbatimStore -> VerbatimStoreApi/isVerbatimStore import swap, disjoint from 3.20.2's regions); merged total verified via `wc -l`. Then +45 (1763->1808) by fix/d5-supersedes-corrects round 2 (finding #2) — the host-level supersession-enforce switch (createLore() option `supersessionEnforce` + LORE_SUPERSESSION_ENFORCE env, precedence per-workspace > createLore option > env > default off): the new CreateLoreOptions field + doc comment, the hostSupersessionDefault computation + resolveEmbeddedSupersession closure (replacing two duplicated inline resolveSupersessionContext blocks in nodeUpsert/nodeUpsertBatch, itself a net reduction), the DaemonWiring field, and one-line supersessionEnforceDefault additions at each of the 4 downstream construction points (createMcpServer call, bulkIngest call, HTTP dispatch deps). Not extracted further: each addition is a single field on an existing DI object at its one construction site — pulling these into a separate module would require passing the whole CreateLoreOptions/DaemonWiring shape across a file boundary for a one-line value, which fragments the same dependency-injection pattern used throughout this file rather than shrinking it. Verified via `wc -l`. (Re-verified via `wc -l` at 1809 after a one-line doc-comment fix on the same branch.) Then +1 (1809->1810) by feat/3.23-d7-piece-vectors (D7a): the single `pieceVectors?: boolean;` field design 2.2 calls for on CreateLoreOptions (with its doc comment on the same line, matching this file's existing single-line-option convention e.g. `searchWorkerPolicy`), plus `opts.pieceVectors` threaded as one more argument onto the two already-existing `createVectorStore({...})` and `new WorkspaceVerbatimResolver(...)` call sites — no new call sites, no new lines at either site itself. Verified via `wc -l`.
